_meta.source: CHP California Crash Reporting System (CCRS), data.ca.gov: Crashes and InjuredWitnessPassengers 2023-2025, County Code 19
_meta.rule: A crash counts for a block group if it is inside it or within 10 m of its boundary; crashes on boundary streets count for each bordering block group.
_meta.pedbike_rule: first object struck is a pedestrian or bicycle, or any party (Parties table) or injured person is a Pedestrian or Bicyclist
fields: killed or seriously injured crashes (any person Fatal, SuspectSerious or SevereInactive, or NumberKilled > 0)
